programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Rising from the rubble of his former base, Dr. Eggman reveals his new battleship, the Egg Fort, and attacks Station Square. Sonic faces off his nemesis once again on X-Tornado.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: The President demands the search for Dr. Eggman after Sonic destroys the Egg Fort. Meanwhile, Sonic and his friends are taking a well-deserved vacation where they discover that another Chaos Emerald is nearby.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga hears about the legendary Tojo, the final and strongest member of Ishiyama's TKKH, from Furuichi. And right away, he goes for a showdown! Well, if he knew where Tojo was. Thanks to Himekawa's digging, Oga, Hilda, and the rest head to the beach where Tojo is supposed to be working part-time...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Furuichi is called back from a resort on a tropical island where he was vacationing with his family to go to the public pool with Oga. At the pool, Furuichi runs into a nasty upperclassmen he knew from middle school, and it's not just him, but Nene and the other Red Tails that are in trouble! Will Furuichi, "the strategist" finally make his move?!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ando is struggling with the fact that his friend Shishigami is responsible for the spree of home invasions. After reading that hospital patients were being cured, Ando theorizes that there is someone else out there with the same powers as Shishigami. Ando lures Inuyashiki by pretending to need help and asks him to stop Shishigami. Meanwhile, Shishigami learns his mother has terminal cancer.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shishigami escaped from a dozen officers, but he has become a wanted man in connection to the home invasion spree. With nowhere to go, Shishigami stays with Shion Watanabe, a classmate who has feelings for him. Meanwhile, Inuyashiki learns to use his robot abilities with Ando's help. After seeing Shishigami's mother publicly apologizing on TV, they worry what Shishigami might do next.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E15 Envoy from the East [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E16 Footsteps of a Comrade-in-Arms [English Dub]
programme.desc: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP15 The Princess and the Thief's Improv [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP16 Kid vs. Conan: Miraculous Airwalking [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid the Phantom Thief literally rises to the occasion when old man Jirokichi of the Suzuki conglomerate throws down the gauntlet. But with Detective Conan as part of the security team guarding the Blue Wonder jewel, will Kaito finally get his wings clipped?

programme.title: BLEACH the Movie 3: Fade to Black [English Dubbing]
programme.desc: Ichigo must fight a lonely battle to save Rukia before the two are forced to part ways forever!

programme.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Movie: Mugen Train [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tanjiro and Nezuko, along with Zenitsu and Inosuke, join one of the most powerful swordsmen within the Demon Slayer Corps, Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku, to face the demon aboard the Mugen Train on track to despair.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.sub-title: EP17 The Adventures of Knuckles and Hawk
programme.desc: Knuckles rescues a man named Hawk from ancient ruins. Discovering later that Hawk had discovered a chaos emerald, Knuckles seeks for him once again in Oriental City. There he is confronted by some local thugs Li Yan and the Bruiser Boys.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When Sonic, Tails, Chris and the Egg Fort crash land on the Nature Continent after a fight, Tails and Chris protest against a dam while Sonic is caught in a battle against Decoe, Bocoe, E-65 and Eggman.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Great Demon Lord decides to send Baby Beel some summer homework on a whim. The gang helps Baby Beel do the homework as best they can, but if they mess up how to use the items in the kit, all of humanity is doomed! Will they actually be able to turn it in on time and in one piece?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Baby Beel comes down with a fever, and Oga's link to him and his never-ending shocking comes to an end. Hilda and Baby Beel disappear, and when Oga goes looking for them he finds Baby Beel stuck on Tojo's back! The battle with the top of the Ishiyama TKKH is here!

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E17 Cold Flame [English Dub]
programme.desc: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E18 The Arrogant Palm of a Small Human [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP17 Green Dream [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid's next target is Green Dream, the world's largest emerald and a one-time-only stage prop for a local play. Though the venue is crawling with cops under Nakamori's command, will Kid be able to make off with Green Dream as well as make a young actress's dream come true?

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.sub-title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP18 Golden Eye (Part One): Chat Noir's Challenge [English Dub]
programme.desc: Kid has a new phantom thief rival in town, who flew all the way from France: Chat Noir! The felonious feline challenges Kid to steal a cat's-eye ring which may have belonged to Marie Antoinette, but this time, tough security measures have also been imported from France.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Sonic and his friends are on a cruise when the Egg Fort appears inside a glacier. As Sonic faces his foes, he receives some help from Knuckles.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: With a single blow from Tojo, Oga learns the difference in their strength and dejectedly returns home. Waiting for him there are a former court physician and his assistant from the Demon World. Oga is thrown into his own mysterious mental subconscious in order to grow as the parent of a Demon Lord.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga is all raring to go finally beat Tojo this time, and Kanzaki and Himekawa try and join forces with him. Then, delinquents come to attack the three! Making it through the forces, Oga finally arrives for his showdown with Tojo...

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The day after the mass killings in Shinjuku, Shishigami begins dropping airplanes onto the city. After receiving word from Ando, Inuyashiki manages to stop a number of them from crashing. He then notices that Mari is trapped inside a burning building, but Shishigami appears and attacks him. Inuyashiki is desperately trying to make his way over to save Mari, but Shishigami is right on his heels.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Saving many lives in Shinjuku, Inuyashiki returns home to open up to his family about his robot body. His family accepts him, and they embrace. After losing both arms, Shishigami goes to Ando who condemns him and Shishigami disappears. Inuyashiki finds out a giant meteor is about to hit earth. With the whole world in chaos, Inuyashiki flys towards the meteor to protect his family.

programme.desc: Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other alive again.

Next, he pulls on the springs attached to the wall with a motorcycle, but Popeye pulls so hard he throws Bluto and the cycle through the building and into a well. Popeye is walking -- or actually, prancing -- behind Olive on the way to the match, so Bluto tries a bit more sabotage: first an oil slick, which slows Popeye down briefly, then some quick-dry cement in a puddle. This gives Popeye cement overshoes, and when he gets to the arena, he's exhausted. Olive stands him up, but Bluto treats him like a punching bag. He's got Popeye on the floor (under the ring), so Olive finally breaks out the spinach. Popeye knocks Bluto through the roof, right into the hospital. The photographers ask for a picture, and Popeye's biceps form the words

programme.title: The Henpecked Rooster 1944
programme.desc: A henpecked rooster and a streetwise mouse team up to thwart the fowl's foul wife.

programme.title: The Star of Bethlehem956
programme.desc: A nativity story animated with music performed by the Glyndeboume Festival Chorus.

programme.title: popeye's 20th anniversary (1080)
programme.desc: Popeye is being honored for his 20 years of films at a dinner hosted by 'Bob Hope' (several other celebrities are present, like 'Jimmy Durante', 'Bing Crosby', 'Jerry Lewis' and 'Dean Martin'). When called on to make a speech, Popeye instead shows clips from two of his movies. Bluto does a slow burn through this, finally stuffing Popeye's trophy onto Popeye's head - but the trophy is full of spinach, so Popeye clobbers Bluto

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: Customers Wanted 1939
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto compete in their penny arcades for Wimpy's business

programme.title: Floor Flusher 1954
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto stop by to see Olive and fix her leaky faucet. Popeye does it better, and Bluto gets jealous, so he starts rerouting Olive's plumbing and causing all sorts of leaks. Popeye needs some help from the goldfish to get to his spinach

programme.title: I Never Changes My Altitude 1937
programme.desc: Popeye is sitting outside Olive's lunchroom at the airport, distraught. She's closed the business to fly away with an aviator (Bluto, of course). But it's hardly what she expected; he has her painting his plane, while it's flying; when she says she's rather go back to Popeye, he tries to throw her off the plane. Popeye sees this, and takes off in a plane, just in time to help her out. The boys get into a dogfight, and Bluto manages to demolish Popeye's plane. As Popeye is falling, he grabs a duck and feeds the duck spinach. The duck manages to fly him up to Bluto's plane, Popeye has some spinach of his own, and he teaches Bluto a lesson. Popeye picks up Olive and crashes the plane into the diner, opening it (and providing a new counter).

programme.title: Quack a Doodle Doo 1950
programme.desc: His Mama is the only one who love Baby Huey, an overgrown clumsy ugly duckling. The other Mamas and their broods shun him like the plague and make his little life miserable. But when a ferocious fox attacks the barnyard, Huey comes to the rescue of one and all. Huey is a hero basking in his new-found popularity. First of the series.

programme.title: Private Snafu - Fighting Tools -1943
programme.desc: Private Snafu

programme.title: Pepe le-Pew - Heaven Scent 1956
programme.desc: On the French Riviera, a female cat is frightened by sudden outbursts of barking by every dog around her. So, to scare them away, she paints her back with a white stripe like that of a skunk. The dogs, on seeing her stripe, run away and hide in fright. But she doesn't receive the peace she'd expected, because Pepe Le Pew, the amorous French skunk, sees her, thinks she's a girl skunk, and tries to make love to her.

programme.title: April Maze-1930
programme.desc: Felix the Cat and his two nephews try to have a picnic, but a thunderstorm and a thieving rabbit prevent them.

programme.title: Superman: Billion Dollar Limited-1950
programme.desc: Superman battles train robbers seeking to steal a billion dollars worth of gold.

programme.title: The Trojan Horse 1960
programme.desc: During the Trojan War, the Greeks build a giant wooden horse as a stratagem to conquer the city of Troy. Adapted from the Greek myth.

programme.title: Me Feelins is Hurt 1940
programme.desc: Olive writes a letter to Popeye: she's through with sailors; it's cowboys for her. Popeye immediately sails off to the West, where he finds, who else, Bluto as the head of the ranch where Olive is enthralled. Bluto gives Popeye a wild horse to ride, and, after a few humiliating defeats, Popeye conquers it (and wins back Olive's heart). Bluto punches Popeye out, and into the clutches of what can best be described as a rattlesnake constrictor. Bluto then starts menacing Olive, so Popeye eats his spinach, saves her, and defeats Bluto and his gang.

programme.title: Popeye's 20th Anniversary 1954
programme.desc: Popeye is being honored for his 20 years of films, in a dinner hosted by 'Bob Hope' (several other celebrities are present, like 'Jimmy Durante', Bing Crosby, 'Jerry Lewis' and 'Dean Martin'). When called on to make a speech, he instead shows clips from two of his movies. Bluto does a slow burn through this, finally stuffing Popeye's trophy onto Popeye's head - but the trophy is full of spinach, so Popeye clobbers Bluto.

programme.title: Ancient Fistory 1953
programme.desc: It's the middle ages (sort of); Popeye is working in Bluto's Beanery. Bluto is going to the ball where Princess Olive will choose her mate. Popeye's fairy godpappy appears and it's a reverse Cinderella story, with a car created from a can of spinach.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom
programme.desc: Popeye is marrying Olive tomorrow; he's ecstatic. She has a dream of the future, including twin sons who prove to be a real handful. When Popeye comes by the next morning, he gets a frosty reception

programme.title: A Haul in One 1956
programme.desc: Popeye and Bluto are, believe it or not, pals and partners in a moving company. (Maybe it's because Popeye isn't squinting here.) Anyhow, Olive has made the mistake of hiring them. She hasn't finished packing yet, so the boys, smitten as soon as she answers the door, compete to help her. Once packed, they compete to move more impressive piles of her belongings. Popeye easily wins these contests, even though Bluto locks him in the van at one point. At the end, Bluto socks Popeye into the piano, then into a table; though he hardly seems to need it, Popeye still eats his spinach, then thrashes Bluto.

programme.title: Boom Boom-1936
programme.desc: World War I, apparently. There is a series of quick blackout gags, including a soldier that throws the pin, is blown sky-high by the grenade, and is caught in a net by an ambulance driver; one soldier's encounters with very smart bullets; a machine gunner with the jitters. Porky leads a charge, but with no support from his company, he runs back and dives under Beans' bunk. After a quick chorus of "You're in the Army Now," a messenger pigeon drops in with news that General Hardtack is being held prisoner. They dash off in a motorcycle/sidecar, chased by another smart bullet, and arrive in the nick of time to dispatch the general's captors. They fly off in a plane and get shot down to end up together in the hospital.

programme.title: Fox Pop 1942
programme.desc: Hearing that silver foxes are all the rage in high society, a fox paints himself silver and gets himself trapped, finding out too late that it's only his fur anyone is interested in

programme.title: Felix Minds the Kid 1922
programme.desc: After unsuccessfully trying to steal food from a fish market, Felix is promised by a man that if he watches the man's child, he will be fed a great meal. Unfortunately, the baby swallows a balloon and floats out the window, and Felix has to find him and bring him back before the man gets home.

programme.title: Superman cartoons 6
programme.desc: Superman cartoons 6

programme.title: Patriotic Popeye (1080)
programme.desc: Popeye is enjoying watering his patriotic garden on July 4 when he catches his nephews attempting to light fireworks. The game is on when he attempts to confiscate the fireworks and the boys strike back with edgy pranks. Bluto and Olive Oyl do not appear in this cartoon.

programme.title: Cookin' with Gags 1955
programme.desc: The boys are taking Olive on a picnic. It's April 1, and Bluto plays a series of "jokes" on Popeye, though of course they go beyond the bounds of acceptability, particularly once they get to the picnic grounds; Bluto puts gasoline on the fire he asks Popeye to light and swaps a beehive for the lemonade. Bluto then launches a cruel joke against Olive and frames Popeye. The capper: he replaces Popeye's spinach with a joke can, and runs off with Olive for some canoeing. But Popeye gets the last laugh with an inflatable sea monster.

programme.title: A Date to Skate 1938
programme.desc: Popeye takes Olive roller skating in a rink; she's never skated before, so he has to teach her, and she's not exactly a quick learner. After a while, she ends up outside the rink, and still out of control; she skates through a department store and causes major traffic problems. When she gets stuck on a speeding fire truck, Popeye realizes he'll need his spinach, but he's out fortunately, an audience member tosses him a can.

programme.title: The Underground World-1943
programme.desc: Lois Lane and an explorer set out on an expedition through an underground cavern and discover a race of hawk-men. When these creatures prepare a ritual sacrifice for the adventurous pair, Superman comes to the rescue.

programme.title: The Booze Hangs High-1930

programme.title: Rocket Bye Baby 1956
programme.desc: A cosmic mix-up results in a Martian baby being delivered to Earth, while an Earth baby is sent to Mars. Joseph Wilbur and his wife try to raise the green-skinned, ingenious Martian tyke as if he were an Earthling. But the kid builds his own spaceship and flies away, and Wilbur must find him and bring him back, or he'll never be able to make an exchange with the Martian parents for his own boy.

programme.title: Felix Goes A-Hunting-1923
programme.desc: A wife throws her husband out of the house, telling him not to return unless he brings her a fur coat. Deciding that the only way he'll get one is to make his own, he grabs his rifle and goes hunting. All his efforts fail, though, until he meets Felix, who offers to help him shoot rabbits, and impresses the man with his marksmanship skills. However, it turns out that shooting the rabbits isn't quite as easy as they thought it would be.

programme.desc: Charlie Dog tries everything to get Porky to take him in and he finally does. After a couple pranks the dog pound ends up picking up Porky and not the dog.

programme.title: Felix in the Bone Age-1922
programme.desc: Felix comes upon a caveman and his girlfriend. The girlfriend is crying, and when the caveman asks her what she wants, she points to Felix. The caveman chases Felix, who escapes by using the tails of some friendly monkeys to make his way down a steep cliff. Later he makes friends with a baby monkey, but winds up getting in a fight with a huge gorilla.

programme.title: Much ado About Nutting 1953
programme.desc: A squirrel in a downtown park lugs a giant coconut back home, but nothing he does can seem to crack it open.

programme.title: My Favorite Duck 1942
programme.desc: Porky tries to relax on a hunting and fishing trip, but Daffy, smugly pointing out the "No Duck Hunting" signs, subjects him to constant irritation. Then the "Duck Hunting Season Open" signs start going up.

programme.title: In the Bag-1932
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry crash their plane in the cartoon wild, wild west. Surreal hi-jinx involving a vicious outlaw and robbery ensue.

programme.title: Betty Boop with Henry the Funniest Living American-1935
programme.desc: Henry, comic strip character, gets a job at Betty Boop's pet store

programme.title: Pest Pupil 1957
programme.desc: Baby Huey, the over-sized duck, is enrolled in kindergarten but his size and clumsy attempts to fit in causes such havoc that he is expelled by the teacher. His mother then hires a private tutor, who is led a life of misery due to Huey's efforts to do good that unintentionally backfire. But the tutor winds up in the ocean---unless Huey lived on a shark-infested lake---and and is about to become a shark meal but Huey saves his life...and gets his diploma as a reward from the grateful tutor.

programme.title: Boo Moon
programme.desc: Casper emerges from a subway station, following a crowd of scared strangers. He encounters a man saying "see the wonders of the moon for ten cents," and offering a sight through a telescope. Casper scares the man away, then uses the telescope to see the moon. He then flies to the moon for a visit. Casper lands on the moon, disappointed to find no man on the moon. He lies down to nap, then tiny moon men emerge from holes. They capture Casper, like Lilliputians did to Gulliver, then place him in a cage on wheels, in which they tow him to the Ruler of the Moon, King Luna. The King addresses Casper as a monster, and treats him as an enemy. Casper playfully picks up King Luna, and the king has him placed in the royal dungeon. A dejected Casper is imprisoned. Then animated trees attack the city of the moon men. The moon men defend their fortified city with flaming missiles. The tree monsters fight back with water, then break through the town walls. When the fight seems lost to the tree monsters, Casper escapes his cage, and helps the moon men. Casper goes underground. The friendly ghost then pulls trees' parts through the moon surface and ties them together, immobilizing the trees. The frustrated trees writhe and strain against the knots Casper has tied. Casper and the moon men have won. Then, and only then, does King Luna embrace Casper as a friend. King Luna knights Casper for the valiant defense of his people. Then all the moon men join in singing the Casper theme song.

programme.title: There's Good Boos Tonight 1948
programme.desc: Casper makes friends with a fox cub. But the new friendship is threatened when a fox hunter and his two hounds come on the scene.

programme.title: Boy Meets Dog 1938
programme.desc: A commercial short made for the Bristol-Myers Co. (plugging their toothpaste) that features the characters from the "Reg'lar Fellers" syndicated newspaper comic strip by Gene Byrnes. The plot concerns a boy who has an old grouch for a daddy, runs off, meets a dog and joins a gang of kids. Meanwhile,the old man has a nightmare,where he sees himself as an old sour puss because he doesn't take care of his teeth and gums. He sees an electric sign for Bristol-Myers toothpaste, and that sets him on a more positive course. (The few-seconds of film showing the sign represents the only commercial intrusion in this short)

programme.title: Parlez Vous Woo 1956
programme.desc: Olive is so captived by "The International", a radio personality with a French accent, that she'd rather stay home than go out on a date with Popeye. Bluto, overhearing this, comes to the door as the character. Popeye does his best to get Olive back, to no avail. Finally, Bluto challenges Popeye to a duel, ultimately stabbing him in the chest where his can of spinach was. Popeye unmasks Bluto, then eats another can of spinach to give himself a French accent.

programme.title: Betty Boop- More Pep- 1936
programme.desc: In a return to the 'Out of the Inkwell' format, Betty Boop invents a 'pep' formula to speed up lazy Pudgy, but it escapes into the 'real world' with rapid results.

programme.title: Bride and Gloom

programme.title: Scotty Finds a Home 1935
programme.desc: A young anthropomorphic kitten wants a pet. He happens to find a puppy with no owner and takes him in. When the Scotty tracks mud into the house, Grandma says that her grandson cannot keep him. A transient bulldog is walking by as Grandma puts a pie in the windowsill to cool. He barges into the house and terrorizes the family, demanding they feed him. Scotty rushes back to the house and saves the family, causing Grandma to decide that they can keep him after all.

programme.title: A Ham in a Role 1949
programme.desc: A Shakespearian dog, tired of being a pie-in-the-face looney tune, quits Warner Brothers to study dramatic acting and goes to his country house to practice the bard. He finds that two polite twin gophers have taken over his abode and angrily throws them out. They retaliate by violently heckling him in comical accordance with his Shakespeare speeches.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Discover Shunde's hidden gems-乡观中国5 预告片浅尝烟火 漫赏村光
programme.desc: What does rural China have to offer? That's a question worth exploring! In this episode of Village Voyage, CGTN's Julian Waghann teams up with Absalom Absalom, a traveler from Namibia, as they journey through the ancient villages of Shunde District in Guangzhou: Yang'e Village, Bijiang Village, and Fengjian Water Town. These villages lie in Lingnan, a historical and cultural region in southern China that spans Guangdong, Guangxi, and beyond. Known for its subtropical climate, bustling trade ports, and distinctive Cantonese culture, Lingnan has long been a place where tradition and openness coexist. Together, they wander through lively markets, uncovering the flavors that define Shunde's cuisine. They step into the world of intangible cultural heritage and experience the spirit of "mastery in both culture and martial arts." They also immerse themselves in the beauty of Lingnan, where interwoven waterways and classical gardens reveal a seamless blend of nature and culture. From village lanes to time-honored traditions, witness the vibrant new energy of rural life rising amid the everyday charm of Lingnan.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”. Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port.From the world’s largest stand-alone duty-free mall – a true shopper’s paradise, to the laid-back charm of an “Old Dad Tea” restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and “mermaids” share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China’s most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

They step into the world of intangible cultural heritage and experience the spirit of "mastery in both culture and martial arts." They also immerse themselves in the beauty of Lingnan, where interwoven waterways and classical gardens reveal a seamless blend of nature and culture. From village lanes to time-honored traditions, witness the vibrant new energy of rural life rising amid the everyday charm of Lingnan.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”. Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port.From the world’s largest stand-alone duty-free mall – a true shopper’s paradise, to the laid-back charm of an “Old Dad Tea” restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and “mermaids” share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China’s most famous surfing hotspots.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: Village Voyage: Discover Shunde's hidden gems-乡观中国5 预告片浅尝烟火 漫赏村光
programme.desc: What does rural China have to offer? That's a question worth exploring! In this episode of Village Voyage, CGTN's Julian Waghann teams up with Absalom Absalom, a traveler from Namibia, as they journey through the ancient villages of Shunde District in Guangzhou: Yang'e Village, Bijiang Village, and Fengjian Water Town. These villages lie in Lingnan, a historical and cultural region in southern China that spans Guangdong, Guangxi, and beyond. Known for its subtropical climate, bustling trade ports, and distinctive Cantonese culture, Lingnan has long been a place where tradition and openness coexist. Together, they wander through lively markets, uncovering the flavors that define Shunde's cuisine. They step into the world of intangible cultural heritage and experience the spirit of "mastery in both culture and martial arts." They also immerse themselves in the beauty of Lingnan, where interwoven waterways and classical gardens reveal a seamless blend of nature and culture. From village lanes to time-honored traditions, witness the vibrant new energy of rural life rising amid the everyday charm of Lingnan.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: A Village Homestay in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, our presenter Tianran He’s heading out of Beijing proper, to the city’s Miyun District. There he’ll meet some people running guesthouses who gave up their day jobs, in order to achieve the dream of a place of their own in the country.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. There, he meets Wu Hao, the young head of the Wu-style Baji Quan school. Together, they journey across the North China Plain, from bustling village markets and the family training hall to the Bohai Sea coast, as Kleber experiences Baji Quan’s explosive power first-hand. Along the way, the episode unpacks the idea of “opening the gate”, the key to focused power, and the spirit of spear work. It goes beyond technique to reveal Cangzhou’s rich martial heritage, tracing how Wu-style Baji Quan has travelled from its hometown to Europe, proof that traditional kung fu can endure, evolve, and thrive today. In the end, Wu Hao answers with action: true inheritance is not only about skills, but about shaping spirit and character.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: Tasting the Lifestyle of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode uncovers Chongqing's lifestyle, where hot pot is more than food but a city symbol intertwined with climate and history. Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. Exploring graffiti streets, old teahouses and Hongyadong, we find Chongqing balances vibrancy and leisure amid modern development.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down on a yacht with friends and laughter. Finally, Tianran travels to Baisha for the “La’aomen” harvest festival, where the local ethnic Li people sing, dance and celebrate their most important crop: “Mountain Orchid Rice”.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels
programme.desc: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewel

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.5
programme.desc: Guarded by mountains in southeast China, Jiangxi channels rivers into Poyang Lake---the Yangtze's vital link. Starting from Mount Lu's misty slopes, watch and marvel as northern plains transition into an undulating land of hills and basins...

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai — the world’s largest Miao village — and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: The Great British Theft?
programme.desc: The Parthenon, the crown jewel of Athens, is a 2,500-year-old UNESCO World Heritage Site. Two centuries ago, Lord Elgin dismantled nearly half of its sculptures under false pretense and shipped them back to the British Museum. Today, the Acropolis Museum holds only a fraction of its originals. In this documentary, CGTN visits both sites to pose a candid question. Were his actions in the spirit of preservation, or was it just plunder?

programme.title: The 77 Percent

programme.desc: Cape Town’s iconic beaches and upmarket housing is shadowed by severe inequality and gang violence that plagues many residents. This week, The 77 Percent explores how young people are trying to improve their communities.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Venom, a lethal weapon brandished by hundreds of animals of all shapes and sizes, over land and sea. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we’ll meet three creatures whose venomous sting strikes fear in the hearts of people around the globe.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Nature’s heavyweight battles test the most powerful animals’ killer instincts and their will to live. On this episode, we explore what happens when the world’s most deadly apex predators go head to head for survival!

programme.title: Predator's Playground
programme.desc: This African spring is a lifeline and a trap. Flowing from a sandy riverbed 30 km from the Zambezi, it draws animals from August to November. But cliffs turn it into an ambush zone for lion prides, who strike with deadly precision, taking prey from buffalo to baby elephants. It’s a predator’s playground.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: In 1850, Alfred Russell Wallace investigates the island world of the malayan archipelagos -- and discovers that the nature there is separated into two parts through a mysterious magical border. A border which still bears his name: The 'Wallace-Line.' 150 years later, a new generation of investigators travel to the mysteries Wallace-Line to investigate under water. They dive down to a mystical world, a world in which Wallace was never able to get into. The investors want to find out if a 'marine' Wallace-Line exists.

programme.title: The Best of Worlds: Life at Its Alpine Limits
programme.desc: For 5000 years man has sought to inhabit the more accessible areas of Europe, but at its very heart, in the high zones of the Alps, there exists a world parallel to ours.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: On the trail of his top ten, Nigel meets worshippers and vipers at Penang's famous Snake Temple and meets a new squeeze, a snappy reticulated python over 4 metres long! In hilltop forests there's a red-headed krait and the David Bowie spider. He joins fishermen to net some superb sea snakes. But which of Malaysia's 40 venomous snakes will make the top spot?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Australia's renowned deadly serpents include the inland taipan, the most toxic serpent in the world, and the enormous king brown, which can deliver more venom in a single bite than any other snake. As Nigel counts down his top ten, he's helped by Steve Irwin's son Robert, whose favourite billabong is a prime spot for a snake on Nigel's list.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Every year over a million people are bitten by snakes, resulting in some 46,000 deaths - Nigel tracks down the ten deadliest. He meets an enormous king cobra and the infamous Russell's viper, a snake responsible for more deaths than any other. With the help of the Irula, a tribe of snake hunters, he faces off with kraits, vipers and cobras.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Europe is home to some 50 species of snakes; around 19 of them are venomous. Nigel crosses the continent in search of the most dangerous. On the Greek island of Milos there's an endangered viper that ambushes birds, while in Spain there are Montpellier snakes, asp vipers, colourful lizards and egg-laden toads. Amid ancient Turkish ruins he uncovers a massive Ottoman viper, a snake once used as a weapon of war.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: On the trail of his top ten, Nigel meets worshippers and vipers at Penang's famous Snake Temple and meets a new squeeze, a snappy reticulated python over 4 metres long! In hilltop forests there's a red-headed krait and the David Bowie spider. He joins fishermen to net some superb sea snakes. But which of Malaysia's 40 venomous snakes will make the top spot?

programme.title: Kanga Pan: An African Horror Story
programme.desc: Kanga Pan – An African Horror Story is a spine-chilling, one-off wildlife documentary, the first of its kind. A relatively unknown inland waterhole in Mana Pools National Park, Kanga Pan is a gathering point for a melting pot of wildlife species. On the surface, it looks like a peaceful oasis, offering the cooling refreshment of water and bathing.

programme.title: Strange Creatures of the Batangas Sea
programme.desc: Hidden in the magical underwater world of one of the most biodiverse marine areas on the planet exists a community of spectacular animals more peculiar than we can imagine.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Great Lakes
programme.desc: Through several interlocking stories including the story of maritime commerce and the ships that move cargo through the inland waterway, Mysteries of the Great Lakes will take you on a journey through the greatest lake system in the world, and showcase the amazing geography, ecology, science, and history of the region.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: To many people the thought of sharks can be scary but they’re actually a huge help to our oceans… and have inspired some awesome tech! Danni Washington will take the plunge and swim with sharks, relaying how their skin is being used to fight germs and their senses can help build better robots! And, if you’re still scared of sharks, Danni goes surfing to reveal how scientists are using bio-inspiration to develop wetsuits that should make you nearly invisible to the ocean’s top predators.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: It’s no secret that birds were the inspiration for the first airplanes but, in this episode, host Danni Washington takes a look at how exactly that connection succeeded. She’ll fly planes in tight formation to try to mimic the energy-efficient flight patterns of migrating birds, look at how engineers are inventing wings that change their shape while in flight… and even jump out of a perfectly good plane to test out an innovation based on the flying squirrel!

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Whether you’re on a team, or just having a little fun, sports play a part in most of our lives. In this episode, host Danni Washington discovers how Mother Nature is revamping some of our favorite activities. She straps on roller skates with reinvented wheels that are inspired by how snakes and fish move. She crushes a 20-minute workout that mimics the physiology of little kids. And she sees how a basic component in plants is helping divers see more clearly underwater.

programme.title: Xploration Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Host Danni Washington goes whale watching and discovers the ways whales have inspired new inventions that help us ride bicycles and surfboards better and faster.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Despite its name, the Bronze Age is considered a golden age of civilization: an almost two thousand-year period – practically worldwide – of social and technological advances in weaponry and tools, culture and civil society. Its collapse is regarded as one of the worse disasters of ancient times – more violent and culturally disruptive than the fall of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unsolved disappearances of ships, planes and even trains have intrigued scientists and adventurers for decades. Large as they are in comparison to the humans aboard, it’s no wonder that even after decades of fruitless searches we continue to pursue the enigmas in the history of transportation: the ship that didn’t make it to port, the plane that didn’t land.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Despite our preconceived notions, new evidence discovered by archeologists and researchers continues to baffle the world with unfathomable revelations… like the dark streak of the peaceful Maya, the weaknesses of the fierce Aztec warriors, and the true nature of the priest-­‐like Inca.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: From Salisbury Plain in England, to the southeastern-­‐most point of the Polynesian Islands, to the Giza Plateau in Egypt, intriguing stone monuments rest as the testimony of human greatness, and a huge enigma for modern civilization.

programme.title: Giant Sea Serpent: Meet the Myth
programme.desc: Its 10-meter length and silver ribbon shape inspired the myth of the sea serpent. Off the French Riviera, buoys set 2,000 meters deep attract pelagic species, including the Giant Oarfish—“King of Herrings”—drifting vertically, alone or in pairs. With expert guidance and passionate collaborators, a scientific expedition unveils the biology of this mysterious ambassador of the abyss.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions are on the hunt for giraffe. Meanwhile, researcher Rae accompanies the lions as they encounter nervy hartebeest. The game capture unit are tasked with supplying more zebra for the Ngama release site. And don’t miss the action as hungry Kwali zones in on an unsuspecting zebra. But can she hold on?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Phyre has to be darted to keep the balance in the pride healthy, while Pazza shows off her highly possessive nature with an unsuspecting tortoise. And Milo demonstrates why he wears the pants around here.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We follow the as they walk and stalk. Meat preparation gets weird for some as our volunteers make dinner time more interesting. A brave zebra stallion takes the fight to the ever confident lions. A historical moment is notched up for Wakanaka as she proves her predatory prowess.

programme.title: Dinosaurs Alive!
programme.desc: See the earliest creatures of the Triassic Period to the monsters of the Cretaceous in a 'life-sized' giant screen presentation. Join renowned paleontologists as they discover new fossils and uncover evidence that dinosaur descendants are still among us. Realistic and scientifically-accurate computer generated animation brings dinosaurs back to life -- in a big way!

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Space Junk
programme.desc: After 50 years of launching our dreams into space, we're left with a troubling legacy: a growing ring of orbiting debris that casts a shadow over the future of space exploration. Space Junk 3D is a visually explosive, sensory expanding voyage into our now-threatened Final Frontier. Experience mind-boggling collisions, both natural and manmade. Soar from the stunning depths of Meteor Crater to an unprecedented view of our increasingly crowded orbits -- 22,000 miles above Earth. Join us as the foremost expert, also known as the "Father of Space Junk," guides us through the challenges we face in protecting them, forging a new age of space discovery.

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Battles for survival play out every day in the animal kingdom. For the majority of animals, each battle is an uncertainty. But for a fortunate few, the odds are tilted much more in their favor.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They take their time because they know time is on their side. When the strike happens, it happens in a violent flurry. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the world’s best lurkers.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: They are purr-fect predators. They move with slow purpose. But attack in violent bursts. They are cats, big cats to be precise. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we will meet three of the most magnificent.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Some animals simply take your breath away. Majestic in so many ways, they move with grace and attack with style. On this episode of Killer Instincts, we meet three majestic animals.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: The marine world is home to an eclectic mix of creatures each with their own unique survival skills, voracious hunting tactics and fascinating adaptations. We begin with the barracuda.

programme.title: Killer Instincts
programme.desc: Not all predators sit on top of the food chain. However, all predators need to eat. In the wild, survival often requires one to use the skills nature has provided to create opportunities for success.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Adventure Ocean Quest: The Giants of Rurutu
programme.desc: Humpback whales have come back from the brink of extinction, but they are still difficult to approach in the water and their behaviour and vocalisations pose many unsolved questions. Dr. Michael Poole wants to find out if the whales respond differently to a silent freediver compared to conventional divers, and has asked Frederic to dive with the whales and observe them.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: There are areas around the world where planes, ships, and people seem to vanish without a trace. These zones have been blamed for mysterious phenomena for decades. Each place has an enigmatic and haunting story that has inspired geologists, engineers and archaeologists to study the science behind the myth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It is undisputable that despite their supposedly primitive technology, the societies that flourished almost 2000 years before Christ were able to accomplish unbelievable feats that forever changed the understanding of the world for all humankind.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It was the Dark Ages… and from the cold North Sea a pagan maritime civilization exploded… and brutally raided and terrorized Europe… they were the Vikings.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: China is one of the world’s oldest civilizations and has one of the most well-­‐documented historical accounts in existence. Rich with records of early dynasties, warfare, ancient traditions and architecture, China is home to some of the most amazing archaeological sites in the world.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll examine some of the animal kingdom’s fastest sprinters, like the Cheetah. Also, the mysteries of animal intelligence are revealed as we take a look at Dolphins and Orangutans.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine some of the world’s most fearsome predators. Find out why Owls are the only birds that can fly without making any sound. And how the Leopard uses its amazing night vision to catch its prey.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll feature animals that live in the freezing arctic. Learn how the Polar Bear has developed special adaptations that help it survive in the most unforgiving climate imaginable. And why the Wolverine is able to hunt so efficiently in the snow.

programme.title: Animal Science
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine the science behind man’s best friend – the dog. Find out what makes a greyhound so fast. See how a bloodhound’s nose really works, and the reason that border collies are so intelligent is revealed.

programme.title: Into the Big Blue Heart: Ocean Currents
programme.desc: Jump in the flow of the East Australian Current with migrating humpback whales on a stunning journey that will reveal how the ocean and her currents regulate our climate, shape our lives and nurture incredible biodiversity.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer. This raises questions about what is no doubt a sensitive subject, one that brings to mind our own mortality as we speculate about the reasons for this kind of resilience in our animal counterparts. What lessons can we learn from the animal kingdom? We follow individuals to their last breath ... not as voyeurs, but as spectators attuned to the circle of life.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity? What are some of the benefits associated with aging in nature?

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Reproduction is not only a concern of the young and restless: this episode of Aging in the Wild brings a light-hearted look at the issue of sexuality and camaraderie in older animals. We illustrate, for example, the link between the age of an elephant and its reproductive success. What are the reproductive benefits of these animals as they grow older? Through hearing their stories, we learn of some of the advantages - and disadvantages - of late-life reproduction.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Angkor: The Lost Empire of Cambodia
programme.desc: At the height of its power between the 9th and 15th centuries, Angkor was a resplendent city, considered the most extensive urban complex of the pre-industrial world. But by the late 16th century, the empire was in its death throes. The people of Angkor left not a single word explaining their kingdom's collapse. Come along this giant screen adventure to unveil the mysteries behind this lost jewel of Cambodia!

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: To The Ends Of The Earth
programme.desc: The rise of extreme energy, the end of economic growth, the people caught in the middle. To the Ends of the Earth is a feature documentary about the state of our energy system today, and the people we meet are uniquely positioned to watch this global crossroads unfold. For example, the mayor of an Inuit village in Canada's high Arctic who is concerned that seismic testing for oil in the ocean is blowing up the eardrums of the animals that the Inuit hunt to survive. Or the environmental lawyer who goes on a journey to areas that produce energy for the Tarsands of Alberta – he learns of the inputs of energy that have to be put into this resource - and the reasons why the second largest oil project in the world is economically unsustainable. Or the river conservationist in Utah who fights to protect the Colorado River from oil shale projects that would disturb its headwaters.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Ancient architecture stands as a lasting testimony to human achievement, a visual reflection of the cultural needs and shifting beliefs of civilizations at different points in time. Archeologists avidly study the ancient architecture of the past – temples, buildings and monuments – to reveal clues about the ancient civilizations that created them and understand how past innovation has helped shape the construction of our modern-day world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: In deze aflevering van Ultimate Processes onderzoeken we hoe de AW 101, een van 's werelds meest geavanceerde SAR-helikopters, ontworpen en gebouwd wordt.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: Presentatrice Francesca Chiorando bezoekt een Italiaans bedrijf genaamd Wally, wat een van de best uitziende en technologisch geavanceerde superjachten ter wereld bouwt.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: We zitten middenin een ware fietsrevolutie en vandaag de dag is er wel een fiets voor elke gelegenheid, die Francesca Chiorando probeert er twee uit.

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1

programme.title: Razor: Science For a Better Future S1
